name: Chicken-White Bean Stew with Carrot, Bell Pepper, Dill & Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow onions
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp dill, dried

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
Place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Add beans, chicken, and broth to the pot; stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until veggies and beans are soft, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stew between bowls and top with cheese. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
